title: Custom CSS
description: Optional site-wide custom CSS. When the deployment opts in (AMPLIENCE_CUSTOM_CSS="TRUE"), this is injected after the design tokens as an override — letting the team that owns site config add brand overrides without editing or redeploying tokens.css.

values.title: Site
values.description: Apply the CSS to this site (e.g. acme)

css.title: Custom CSS
css.description: Raw CSS applied site-wide. It is injected after the design tokens (tokens.css) and any [data-brand] overrides, so ordinary selectors take precedence over the defaults by source order — e.g. redefining a --color-* variable on :root overrides the token default without needing !important. Leave blank to inject nothing.
